title: BFA Remote Bridge
tagline: Better Facial Animations' lip sync, worked out on another PC.
description: Runs Better Facial Animations' lip-sync model on another PC on your local network (PandorumLLM's A2F server), so this PC's graphics card is left to the game. Its settings are on this page; the BFARemoteBridge.dll SKSE plugin does the work. Requires Better Facial Animations 4.3.2, SkyrimNet Beta26 or later and Address Library.
author: Pt0l3my
